game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep firewood safe from yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep firewood safe from yeti raiders. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 19.
